heading: Evidence from the vehicle, shop, field, and prototype bench.
intro: These figures are selected for the engineering context they show. Open an image to inspect it at a larger size.

items.title: Competition context
items.caption: Vehicle systems are built for inspection, track-side troubleshooting, and team execution—not just for a desk review.

items.alt: Formula EV low-voltage enclosure held at competition
items.title: Low-voltage hardware
items.caption: A real subsystem is evaluated alongside the car, its interfaces, and the people who need to service it.

items.alt: Industrial control panel interior with organised wiring
items.title: Panel execution
items.caption: Industrial panel assembly reinforced the importance of drawings, wire routing, labelling, and quality checks.

items.alt: Small mechanical vehicle prototype with wheels and linkage
items.title: Mechanical prototype
items.caption: Small-format course prototyping: physical packaging and iteration make design decisions visible quickly.

items.title: Composite layup
items.caption: Early hands-on learning with lamination and fiberglass layups through a built composite deck.

items.alt: Inspection activity around industrial facility equipment
items.title: Field context
items.caption: Asset data and documentation are useful only when they support equipment, inspections, and operating decisions.
